It currently can use CUDA, HIP, SYCL, HPX, OpenMP and C++ threads as backend programming models with several other backends in development.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "5.2.2"
  build_number: 0
  cuda_build_string: ${{ "cuda" ~ cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring ~ "sm" ~ cuda_arch_version | version_to_buildstring }}

package:
  name: kokkos
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/kokkos/kokkos/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 491fe02cb127559dd3c996f6693686f1eab00a53fd5c184e18e663896884175e
  patches:
    - patches/0001-Avoid-min-macro-in-hwloc.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number + (priority | default(0) | int) * 100 }}
  skip:
    - cuda_compiler_version == "None" and cuda_arch_version != "None"
    - cuda_compiler_version != "None" and cuda_arch_version == "None"
    - match(cuda_compiler_version, ">=13.0") and match(cuda_arch_version, "<7.5")
  string: ${{ cuda_build_string if cuda_compiler_version != "None" and cuda_arch_version != "None" else "" }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
  script:
  # Search acronyms on https://en.wikichip.org/ to enable optimizations
  # for each platform for desktop chips released since 2012 (10 years)
  # Build options here: https://kokkos.org/kokkos-core-wiki/get-started/building-from-source.html#configuring-and-building-kokkos
  # FIXME: Cannot optimize for multiple CPU archs simultaneously. For now, don't enable any optimizations.
  #  - Kokkos_OPT_ARGS=-DKokkos_ARCH_AMDAVX=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_BDW=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_HSW=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_SNB=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_ZEN=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_ZEN2=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_ZEN3=ON  # [x86_64 and not osx]
  #  - Kokkos_OPT_ARGS=-DKokkos_ARCH_POWER8=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_POWER9=ON  # [ppc64le]
  #  - Kokkos_OPT_ARGS=-DKokkos_ARCH_ARMV80=ON -DKokkos_ARCH_ARMV81=ON  # [aarch64]
  # Kokkos only lets us target for one CUDA arch at a time, so target the
  # lowest arch supported by each compiler version and include PTX for later archs
    env:
      Kokkos_CUDA_ARGS: ${{ "-DKokkos_ENABLE_CUDA=ON" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "-DKokkos_ENABLE_CUDA=OFF" }}
      Kokkos_OPT_ARGS: ${{ "-DKokkos_ARCH_" ~ Kokkos_ARCH ~ ":BOOL=ON" if Kokkos_ARCH != "None" else "" }}
      Kokkos_TEST_ARGS: -DKokkos_ENABLE_TESTS=OFF

requirements:
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("kokkos") }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - cuda-version
  build:
    - cmake >=3.21.1,<4
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ninja
    - if: unix
      then:
        - sed
    - if: win
      then:
        - sd
  host:
    - libhwloc
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cuda-arch ${{ cuda_arch_version }}.*
        # Will get nvcc linker warnings if the cudatoolkit version doesn't match
        - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - if: not win
          then: cuda-driver-dev
  run:
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - __cuda
        - ${{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", lower_bound="x", upper_bound="x") }}

tests:
  - if: unix
    then:
      - files:
          source:
            - example/build_cmake_installed
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then:
                - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
            - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
            - cmake >=3.27
            - ninja
            # Will get nvcc linker warnings if the cudatoolkit version doesn't match
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then:
                - cuda-arch ${{ cuda_arch_version }}.*
                - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
                - cuda-cudart-dev
                - cuda-driver-dev
                - libcublas-dev
        script:
          # Lots more CMake files; just checking for one
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/cmake/Kokkos/KokkosConfig.cmake
          # Testing explicitly for all shared libs, but not links
          - if: linux
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libkokkoscontainers.so.${{ version }}
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libkokkoscore.so.${{ version }}
              # - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libkokkossimd.so.${{ version }}
          - if: osx
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libkokkoscontainers.${{ version }}.dylib
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libkokkoscore.${{ version }}.dylib
              # - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libkokkossimd.${{ version }}.dylib
          # There are lots more headers; only test for a few.
          # Dumps many headers directly into include/,
          # but all files are prefixed with Kokkos_
          - test -f $PREFIX/include/Kokkos_Core.hpp
          # These are all the binaries
          - test -f $PREFIX/bin/hpcbind
          - test -f $PREFIX/bin/kokkos_launch_compiler
          - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/bin/nvcc_wrapper
              # Test compilation with kokkos
              - cd example/build_cmake_installed
              # Prevent error during configuration due to CUDA::cudart not found
              # Must come after project() so the platform is initialized
              - sed -i 's/^find_package(Kokkos/find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED COMPONENTS cudart cuda_driver)\n&/' CMakeLists.txt
              - cmake -GNinja ${CMAKE_ARGS} -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release .
              - cmake --build .
              # Running example requires loading the CUDA driver
              # - ./example 1000 --help
          - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None" and linux
            then:
              # Test compilation with kokkos
              - cd example/build_cmake_installed
              - cmake -GNinja ${CMAKE_ARGS} -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release .
              - cmake --build .
              - ./example 1000 --help
  - if: win
    then:
      - files:
          source:
            - example/build_cmake_installed
            - example/build_cmake_installed_kk_as_language
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then:
                - ${{ compiler('cuda') }}
            - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
            - cmake >=3.27
            - ninja
            - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
              then:
                - cuda-arch ${{ cuda_arch_version }}.*
                - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
                - cuda-cudart-dev
        script:
          # Lots more CMake files; just checking for one
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\cmake\Kokkos\KokkosConfig.cmake exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\kokkoscontainers.lib exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\kokkoscore.lib exit 1
          # - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\kokkossimd.lib exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\kokkoscontainers.dll exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\kokkoscore.dll exit 1
          # - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\kokkossimd.dll exit 1
          # There are lots more headers; only test for a few.
          # Dumps many headers directly into include/,
          # but all files are prefixed with Kokkos_
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\Kokkos_Core.hpp exit 1
          # These are all the binaries
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\hpcbind exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\kokkos_launch_compiler exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\nvcc_wrapper exit 1
          # Test compilation with kokkos
          # flang puts clang++ on PATH; Kokkos flags are MSVC-style, so force cl
          - set CC=cl
          - set CXX=cl
          # Short build dirs: the object path limit is 250 characters
          # This example compiles C++ with cl, which cannot compile CUDA
          - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
            then:
              - cmake -GNinja %CMAKE_ARGS% -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -S example\build_cmake_installed -B b1
              - cmake --build b1
              - ctest --test-dir b1 --output-on-failure
          # Kokkos is built with COMPILE_AS_CMAKE_LANGUAGE on Windows
          - cmake -GNinja %CMAKE_ARGS% -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -S example\build_cmake_installed_kk_as_language -B b2
          - cmake --build b2
          # Running a CUDA example requires loading the CUDA driver
          - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
            then:
              - ctest --test-dir b2 --output-on-failure

about:
  homepage: https://kokkos.org/
  summary: >
    Kokkos C++ Performance Portability Programming EcoSystem: The Programming Model - Parallel Execution and Memory Abstraction
  description: >
    Kokkos Core implements a programming model in C++ for writing performance portable applications targeting all major HPC platforms. For that purpose it provides abstractions for both parallel execution of code and data management. Kokkos is designed to target complex node architectures with N-level memory hierarchies
    and multiple types of execution resources. It currently can use CUDA, HIP, SYCL, HPX, OpenMP and C++ threads as backend programming models with several other backends in development.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://github.com/kokkos/kokkos/wiki
  repository: https://github.com/kokkos/kokkos

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - vincentmr
    - BastianZim
    - carterbox
    - fbordeu
